  • Method Details

    • load

      @Transactional public <T> Optional<KfePreparedExecutionService.StoredPayload<T>> load(UUID outboxId, UUID transactionId, UUID claimToken, String operation, KfePreparedExecutionService.PayloadType payloadType, Class<T> payloadClass)
      Loads a previously prepared provider payload only while the caller owns a live execution lease. Returns empty only when all prepared fields are absent; partially populated persisted state is treated as corruption instead of silently rebuilding a potentially different provider request.
      Type Parameters:
      T - provider payload type
      Parameters:
      outboxId - execution outbox identifier
      transactionId - associated financial transaction identifier
      claimToken - current worker lease token
      operation - expected outbox operation
      payloadType - expected provider payload family
      payloadClass - Java type to materialize from the encrypted JSON payload
      Returns:
      stored payload/reference when already prepared, otherwise empty

    • persistIfAbsent

      @Transactional public <T> KfePreparedExecutionService.StoredPayload<T> persistIfAbsent(UUID outboxId, UUID transactionId, UUID claimToken, String operation, KfePreparedExecutionService.PayloadType payloadType, T payload, String executionReference, Class<T> payloadClass)
      Persists the exact provider-ready payload once under the current live claim, returning the existing value on retries. Envelope identity, payload type, operation, and transaction are authenticated as encryption associated data and checked again after decryption.
      Type Parameters:
      T - provider payload type
      Parameters:
      outboxId - execution outbox identifier
      transactionId - associated financial transaction identifier
      claimToken - current worker lease token
      operation - expected outbox operation
      payloadType - provider payload family
      payload - exact typed provider request to preserve across retries
      executionReference - stable provider reference, 1 to 255 trimmed characters
      payloadClass - expected Java payload type for existing-payload recovery
      Returns:
      persisted or previously stored payload and stable execution reference
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for missing payload or invalid reference/size
      KfeExecutionClaimLostException - when the lease is absent, expired, or owned by another worker
